description: Middleware, validators, and the timeline service. Depends on FEAT-001 (AppError, models). These three layers are independent of each other at the file level but all depend on FEAT-001 foundation files, so they are batched into one FEAT for efficiency.
steps: Create backend/src/middleware/auth.js: require AppError and jwtConfig. Export authenticate = async(req,res,next) => { extract Bearer token from req.headers.authorization; if missing throw AppError('No token',401); verify with verifyAccessToken; find User by decoded.id with .select('+isActive'); if not found or not active throw AppError('Unauthorized',401); req.user = user; next(); }. Export authorize = (...roles) => (req,res,next) => { if(!roles.includes(req.user.role)) throw AppError('Forbidden',403); next(); }.

Create backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.js: module.exports = (err,req,res,next) => { let { statusCode=500, message, errors=[], stack } = err; if(err.name==='ValidationError') handle Mongoose validation (statusCode=400, map err.errors to array); if(err.name==='CastError') statusCode=400, message='Invalid ID format'; if(err.code===11000) { statusCode=409; const field=Object.keys(err.keyValue)[0]; message=`${field} already exists`; } if(err.name==='JsonWebTokenError'||err.name==='TokenExpiredError') statusCode=401, message='Invalid or expired token'; const response = { success:false, message, ...(errors.length&&{errors}), ...(process.env.NODE_ENV==='development'&&{stack}) }; res.status(statusCode).json(response); }.

Create backend/src/middleware/validate.js: const { z } = require('zod'); const AppError = require('../utils/AppError'); module.exports = (schema) => async(req,res,next) => { try { req.body = await schema.parseAsync(req.body); next(); } catch(err) { if(err instanceof z.ZodError) { const errors = err.issues.map(i=>({field:i.path.join('.'), message:i.message})); return next(new AppError('Validation failed',400,errors)); } next(err); } };

Create backend/src/validators/auth.validators.js: const {z}=require('zod'); exports.registerSchema = z.object({ name:z.string().min(1).max(100), email:z.string().email(), password:z.string().min(8).regex(/^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d)/,'Password must contain letters and numbers'), role:z.enum(['admin','sales_manager','sales_executive']).optional(), phone:z.string().optional() }); exports.loginSchema = z.object({ email:z.string().email(), password:z.string().min(1) }); exports.refreshTokenSchema = z.object({ refreshToken:z.string().optional() });

Create backend/src/validators/user.validators.js: createUserSchema (same as registerSchema but role required), updateUserSchema (all fields optional with z.object({...}).partial()), changePasswordSchema ({ currentPassword, newPassword min 8 }).

Create backend/src/validators/lead.validators.js: createLeadSchema ({ name required, email optional, phone optional, company optional, source enum optional, status enum optional, priority enum optional, assignedTo z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/).optional(), description optional }). updateLeadSchema = createLeadSchema.partial(). assignLeadSchema = z.object({ assignedTo: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/,'Invalid user ID') }). convertLeadSchema = z.object({ dealTitle:z.string().min(1), dealValue:z.number().positive(), dealStage:z.enum([...]).optional(), expectedCloseDate:z.string().datetime().optional(), customerData:z.object({name:z.string(),email:z.string().email().optional(),...}).optional() }).

Create backend/src/validators/customer.validators.js: createCustomerSchema ({ name required, email optional, phone optional, company optional, address optional object {street,city,state,country,zip all optional strings}, assignedTo optional ObjectId string }). updateCustomerSchema = createCustomerSchema.partial().

Create backend/src/validators/deal.validators.js: createDealSchema ({ title required, lead optional ObjectId string, customer optional ObjectId string, assignedTo optional ObjectId string, value z.number().min(0), probability z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(), expectedCloseDate optional, stage enum optional, description optional }). updateDealSchema = createDealSchema.partial(). updateStageSchema = z.object({ stage:z.enum(['qualification','discovery','proposal','negotiation','won','lost']), lostReason:z.string().optional(), value:z.number().positive().optional(), probability:z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(), expectedCloseDate:z.string().optional() }).superRefine((data,ctx)=>{ if(data.stage==='lost'&&!data.lostReason) ctx.addIssue({path:['lostReason'],message:'lostReason required when stage is lost',code:'custom'}); if(data.stage==='won'&&!data.expectedCloseDate) ctx.addIssue({path:['expectedCloseDate'],message:'expectedCloseDate required when stage is won',code:'custom'}); }).

Create backend/src/validators/activity.validators.js: createActivitySchema ({ type required enum, title required, description optional, assignedTo optional ObjectId string, dueDate optional z.string().datetime(), relatedTo: z.object({ entityId:z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/), entityType:z.enum(['lead','customer','deal']) }) required }). updateActivitySchema = createActivitySchema.partial().

Create backend/src/services/timeline.service.js: const Timeline = require('../models/Timeline.model'); exports.createTimelineEntry = async({ action, entityType, entityId, performedBy, previousValue=null, newValue=null, description='', session=null }) => { const opts = session ? { session } : {}; const entry = await Timeline.create([{ action, entityType, entityId, performedBy, previousValue, newValue, description }], opts); return entry[0]; }; exports.getTimeline = async(entityType, entityId, page=1, limit=20) => { const skip=(page-1)*limit; const [entries,total] = await Promise.all([ Timeline.find({entityType,entityId}).populate('performedBy','name email').sort({createdAt:-1}).skip(skip).limit(limit), Timeline.countDocuments({entityType,entityId}) ]); return { entries, total, page, totalPages:Math.ceil(total/limit) }; };
acceptance_criteria: authenticate middleware attaches req.user and calls next() for valid token
authenticate throws AppError(401) when no token provided
authorize('admin') throws AppError(403) for non-admin user
validate(schema) middleware calls next(AppError(400)) on Zod validation failure
errorHandler converts Mongoose CastError to 400 response
All 6 validator files export their schemas
verification: node -e "const v=require('./src/validators/deal.validators'); v.updateStageSchema.parseAsync({stage:'lost'}).catch(e=>console.log('EXPECTED FAIL:', e.issues[0].message))" — prints lostReason error
findings: All middleware (auth, errorHandler, validate), validators (auth, user, lead, customer, deal, activity), and timeline service implemented successfully. Verifications pass: authenticate/authorize middleware extract tokens and enforce roles; errorHandler converts Mongoose/JWT errors to appropriate HTTP status codes; validate middleware integrates Zod schemas; deal.validators updateStageSchema enforces lostReason for 'lost' stage and expectedCloseDate for 'won' stage via superRefine; timeline.service supports optional session parameter for transaction support.
